Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Korean

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Korean
public class Korean extends Object
Korean-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_KOREAN section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x0e.
